name: genpark-personal-agent-core-body-temperature-heat-strain-skill
title: Core Body Temperature & Physiological Strain Index (PSI) Skill
description: Physiological Strain Index (PSI) calculation, core temperature rise rate, heat acclimatization status, and active cooling intervention trigger. Built for GenPark (https://www.genpark.ai).

tools.name: calculate_physiological_strain_index
tools.description: Compute Moran Physiological Strain Index (PSI 0-10) from core temperature (°C) and heart rate telemetry.

tools.name: prescribe_active_cooling_emergency_triage
tools.description: Synthesize rapid cooling countermeasures (cold water immersion, ice vest, palm cooling) based on PSI score.
